debugData.name: Leaf litter
debugData.description: Leaf litter cards (p308 D5) on generateLeafCard's quads: input albedo the leaf atlas's slot (leafLitter.albedo, ambientCG LeafSet024), a leaf cell per instance by a hash of its instanceIndex (one material and one draw a scatter cell), fitted at its aspect; a share of the leaves (autumn, 0.6) turned toward autumnColor; × tint and the instance's colour; alpha-tested at 0.5 (the atlas's alpha coverage), alphaToCoverage under MSAA. Static define wet (SIMPLE, NONE): wet by the surface conditions by porosity, wetDarkening, wetRoughness. Numbers and colours (optional inputs): autumn, autumnColor, tint, roughness, porosity, wetDarkening, wetRoughness.
